description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Dark/Holy, [Zenith Mode] [Zenith Mode: Cid Raines (Seraphic Shift)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Cid Raines (Seraphic Shift)
description.text: Increases [Holy/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Holy or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Raines (Seraphic Shift) after using two Holy or Dark abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Seraphic Wing+
description.text: Six single attacks (3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [Doom: 45] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Cid Raines (Seraphic Shift)
description.text: Two single attacks (2.66/3.01 each) capped at 9999/19999 if the user's Doom timer is below 20, higher multiplier if exploiting holy/dark weakness and the user's Doom timer is below 20.  Grants [Buff Dark 10% (5s)] and [Buff Holy 10% (5s)] to all allies.

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
